name: Workshop Entrance
summary: Past the Train Depot, Workshop Entrance offers another way into Gnomeregan. The passage skirts the front gates and reaches the Engineering Labs in the irradiated city.

sections.title: The Backdoor to the City
sections.body: Past the Train Depot, Workshop Entrance crosses the cavernous workshop floor toward Gnomeregan’s industrial heart. The opening to the Loading Room lies on one side. The passage runs straight to the Engineering Labs, away from the fortified gates near the surface. There, leper gnomes and troggs contest the way. Those seeking to reclaim the underground capital can use this side door to bypass the first perimeter.

faq.q: Where is the Workshop Entrance located?
faq.answer: Workshop Entrance lies across the workshop floor, past the Train Depot in Gnomeregan’s outer corridors. The opening to the Loading Room is to your left.

faq.q: Why is this area called the backdoor?
faq.answer: The name comes from its use as another way into Gnomeregan’s interior. It skips the main front gauntlet and leads toward the Engineering Labs.

faq.q: Where does this doorway lead inside the city?
faq.answer: The doorway opens onto a hallway that leads directly to the Engineering Labs, deep inside Gnomeregan.

angles.text: As a gnome, you know every secret doorway into Gnomeregan could aid the effort to reclaim lost workshops and recover prototype machinery from Mekgineer Thermaplugg’s forces.
As an engineer, you can take this corridor toward the Engineering Labs. Cutting-edge schematics may draw tinkerers to infiltrate.
